subject.title: feat(chat): migrate chat surface to Reactor

question: Should OpenClaw adopt Microsoft UI Reactor as the supported production renderer for the default native chat surface before the related bottom-origin and streaming-follow design is complete?
rationale: This is a framework-level replacement of the primary chat view rather than a narrow bug fix, and the linked open work still owns important scrolling semantics.

options.title: Land Reactor incrementally
options.body: Accept the renderer migration after focused proof and accessibility review while tracking the remaining virtualizing-layout and streaming-follow work separately.

options.title: Wait for complete scroll behavior
options.body: Pause this PR until bottom-origin layout and hardened streaming follow can be reviewed as one end-to-end interaction design.

recommendation.title: Land Reactor incrementally
recommendation.body: Accept the renderer migration after focused proof and accessibility review while tracking the remaining virtualizing-layout and streaming-follow work separately.
